question: By what means does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching in this address?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker acknowledges knowing the Kaula determination.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the one addressed.
inference: It is by the grace of the lord of the Kaulas that the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The extent of that knowledge is not specified.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
